evaluation_status.classification: exploratory; historical outer folds were reused during iterative strategy development
evaluation_status.required_confirmation: pre-register the current rules and evaluate only sessions after the last inspected date

protocol.name: nested rolling-origin timestamp-safe news veto
protocol.news_model: hashed word unigram/bigram features plus balanced logistic regression
protocol.label: next-session open-to-close return exceeds modeled round-trip friction
protocol.availability: pre-15:50 WIB same date; later or date-only next date; weekend carried to next session
protocol.news_memory: documents contain only news made available during the current and previous four trading sessions
protocol.selection: within one run, quant config and news threshold are selected on the inner window before scoring the outer fold; repeated research runs have contaminated those outer folds
protocol.risk_off_policy: stay in cash for the next outer fold when no inner candidate passes all constraints
protocol.take_profit_policy: fixed 3x or 5x entry ATR target, or disabled; chosen only on the inner window; stop wins when both levels touch in one daily candle
